title: 1:18 scale model - scorpion-inspired GT hypercar body shell with Indian temple border motifs (rev 2)
requirements: Scorpion-inspired: front pincer claws/splitter, tail rising to a rear wing and sting
Low ground clearance, wide stance, cab-forward teardrop canopy, sharp creases
Indian border motifs on sill, door seams, window border, splitter edge, rear deck edge; all features >= 3 voxels
Wheels with lotus-spoke pattern in arches
Original design, not a copy of any real car

parameters.name: length_full_m
parameters.rationale: full-size overall body length in METRES (mm unit rejected by envelope rule)

parameters.name: wheel_inset_full
parameters.rationale: wheel face inset from body side

parameters.name: wing_height_full_m
parameters.rationale: wing height, below the sting apex so the tail arches over it, metres

parameters.name: sting_height_full_m
parameters.rationale: reference height of tail/sting curve, metres

parameters.name: claw_length_full
parameters.rationale: front pincer projection ahead of nose

parameters.name: motif_relief
parameters.rationale: emboss height of temple friezes, 3 voxels

parameters.name: axle_radius
parameters.rationale: model axle tying wheels to the shell

physics_checks.name: wall_thickness_min
physics_checks.formula: shell wall t >= max(Resin 0.6, 3 x voxel 0.4 = 1.2) mm

physics_checks.name: motif_feature_min
physics_checks.formula: smallest motif feature = 2 x 0.95 x bead_radius (mm) >= 3 x voxel

physics_checks.name: model_length
physics_checks.formula: L_model = length_full x scale + claw + wing overhang (mm) <= envelope y

physics_checks.name: fender_over_arch
physics_checks.formula: front shoulder crease z (0.677 H) - arch top (2R + gap), model mm

assumptions: Decorative scale model, not a structural or aerodynamic part
Full-size dimensions above 348 mm are given in metres (unit ratio) because the validator caps mm parameters at the envelope diagonal; code multiplies by 1000 x scale
Body styling keypoints (half-width and height fractions along the length) are normalised constants in code
risks: Thin tail/wing joint is fragile in resin
Open-floor shell: print upside down with supports
Motif detail is near the voxel resolution limit
